## Your Turn: Guided Practice

Working **on your own machine**, repeat the demo with your own Quarto file:

1.  New Quarto Project with Git enabled (or add Git to an existing project: `usethis::use_git()`)

    ```{r}
    #NEW PROJ
    # file -> new proj -> new directory -> quartro proj -> name -> parent folder -> check create git repo -> create proj -> look for git tab

    #OR:
      #open a proj and run usethis::use_git() in consol
    ```

    **ISSUES:**

    No Git tab: check Tools → Project Options → Git/SVN and confirm Git is selected.

    no package: install.packages("usethis")

2.  Create `my_penguins.qmd`. Load `tidyverse` and `palmerpenguins`.

    ```{r}
    #file -> new file -> quarto doc

    library(tidyverse)
    install.packages("palmerpenguins")
    library(palmerpenguins)
    ```

3.  Add **one summary table** (e.g., average bill length by species) and **one plot** of your choosing.

    ```{r}
    #tbl
    bill_summary <- penguins |>
      group_by(species) |>
      summarise(
        average_bill_length_mm = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    bill_summary

    #plot
    penguins |>
      filter(!is.na(bill_length_mm)) |>
      ggplot(aes(x = species, y = bill_length_mm, fill = species)) +
      geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
      labs(
        title = "Bill length by penguin species",
        x = "Species",
        y = "Bill length (mm)"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    ```

4.  Render the document to check it works.(each times)

5.  Commit — **at least twice**, with real messages (e.g., once after the table, once after the plot).

    ```{r}
    #save -> git -> check the box for <>.qmd ->include all for first commit -> commit -> enter real comment -> commit
    ```

    **ISSUES**

    “Please tell me who you are”:

    --consol: usethis::use_git_config( scope = "user", user.name = "Your First and Last Name", user.email = "your-email\@example.com" )

    -- terminal: git config --global user.name "Your First and Last Name" git config --global user.email "your-email\@example.com"

6.  Run `usethis::use_github()` to create your repo and push.

    --in console

    **ISSUES**

    --bad credentials/no token:

    ----run:

    ```         
    usethis::create_github_token()
    ```

    ----then after making:

    ```         
    gitcreds::gitcreds_set()
    ```

    ----to make new: 2
